name: Raymond Bonnett
headline: Vice President Of Professional Services
about:
Senior Technology Executive driving value at the intersection of people, processes and technology.

• Solution-Focused Customer Experiences and Technology leader, Strategist & Change Agent with 25+ years of experience with a major global healthcare software provider (Cerner/Siemens Medical Solutions). Led a technology division with 160+ engineers. Managed annual revenue up to $285M. Earned top honors including Chairman’s Excellence Award

• Developed, improved, and transformed technology and operational infrastructures to create profitable, scalable businesses. Partnered with senior executives to align IT solutions with corporate objectives. Planned strategies to turnaround underperforming divisions. Built and led onshore and offshore cross-functional teams

• Devised innovative solutions to increase company capabilities, capacity, and revenue. Enhanced value for physician and patient communities by leveraging technology to improve clinical services, reduce costs, and increase productivity. Provided company and clients with competitive advantages in the marketplace

Core Capabilities:
• Executive Leadership & Strategic Planning

• Success / client experience

experiences.description: Delivering services to deliver critical services to our customers, ensuring successful value realization, while maintain critical business results for the organization.  Key service deliverables: on time, on budget, successful implementations, education/training, recurring managed operations services / BPO, staff augmentation and adoption to support a growing P&L.

Leading the global professional services organization, I focus on helping healthcare organizations collaborate on, and exchange data, reduce operating costs, maintain compliance with industry regulations and accelerate adoption of alternative payment models through innovative software solutions.

Leading the global professional services division we drive adoption of world class EMR and surround solutions throughout the ambulatory healthcare markets.  Delivering higher quality patient care, business operations and outcomes and reimbursements.  Digital transformation of company wide services organization to standardize project delivery platforms and delivery models ensuring a deeper, richer and more consistent client experience.

Provide business acumen and industry expertise to entrepreneurs for a global angel investor network with more than 2,500 accredited members, with 47 chapters on three continents. Helped ensure optimal matches for investing in early-stage launch/growth companies in healthcare and life sciences. Member of multiple due diligence teams.

Orchestrated & implemented a large-scale transformation of MobileMD, a recently acquired SaaS-based software technology co. Developed strategies to build a scalable business & integrate MobileMD within the Siemens/Cerner family to ensure corporate alignment & facilitate the company’s rapid growth.
• Restructured the company’s technology & operational foundation. Designed & executed systems & processes to convert the company from a 60-person startup with $20M in revenue into a thriving business with 200+ employees & $100M in revenue.
• Devised a 36mos plan for full integration & transformation that incorporated core systems, including customer service (ticketing), project management, & development to support offshore & onshore operations.
- 20-30% cost reductions through consolidation & the elimination of antiquated technologies. 
• Designed an integrated solution to streamline the end-to-end process, which reduced implementation time from 12-18 mos to 9-12 mos, & reduced costs by 33%. Increased efficiency by automating time0consuming manual processes.
• Created PMO model to better support the project management process  & deliver profitable projects. Designed project management guidelines, client care & account governance plans, scorecards, & outreach programs.
• Reconfigured the workforce to improve capacity, expand capabilities, & accommodate the company’s rapid growth. Grew the organization from 60 to 200 FTEs. Redesigned roles & engineered workflows to focus on high-skill labor specializations.
• Created an offshore operation that represented 15% of workforce. Built resources & directed training of staff for testing, engineering, & project management functions. Increased productivity four-fold, reduced labor costs, decreased cycle time, and provided the company with 24/7 functionality.
• Executive Sponsor for 12 top-tier clients. Enabled large hospital accounts to provide higher-quality service across the care continuum, increase patient load, & grow revenue.

experiences.position: Sr. Director It, Technology Consulting: Siemens Medical Solutions
experiences.description:
Managed P&L for a high-volume national technology consulting practice, consisting of 160+ engineers who planned and coordinated implementations for healthcare delivery networks. Managed multiple channel partners and vendor relationships. Promoted significant organic growth through new solution and product development.

• Grew revenue from $30M to $38M in three years by creating new services. Established multimillion-dollar revenue streams by identifying gaps in the marketplace and partnering with vendors to design new mobility products and solutions. Expanded customer base and developed a $100M pipeline.

• Built a highly productive workforce to achieve scalable growth. Introduced an offshore labor component, restructured existing roles, and established a tiered delivery model. Managed an $18M budget and supported a $95M hardware business. Maintained expense growth of less than 7% while increasing revenue more than 26%.

Led the Professional Services organization, consisting of 650+ application and technology consulting experts who supported more than $180M in annual revenue. Planned and implemented a global delivery strategy for high-level implementation and consulting services. Generated 6+ organic revenue growth by developing new programs and services. Exceeded business improvement targets by 65% and reduced non-billable costs by more than 11%.

Drove revenue growth of 8-12% annually for a national consulting practice that focused on providing clinical and financial application services to support legacy solution sets. Managed a $50M budget and led a team consisting of seven practice managers and 120 service providers. Served as client executive sponsor for professional services. Generated annual cost reductions averaging $880K. Initiated quality improvements, which reduced rework by 21%.
